questions.q: Why did Dr. Tenma build Astro Boy?
options: To serve as a lab assistant
To guard the Ministry of Science
questions.why: Tenma lost his son Tobio and built a robot boy to take his place, though the robot could not grow up.

questions.q: Which manga artist created Astro Boy?
questions.why: Osamu Tezuka introduced the character in 1951 and made him the star of his own manga the next year.

questions.q: Astro Boy's robot strength is usually given as how many horsepower?
questions.why: The robot hero is famous for a strength rating of 100K horsepower, along with jet flight.

questions.q: What is the Japanese name of Astro Boy's younger sister, known in English as Astro Girl?
questions.why: Uran is Atom's sister, known as Astro Girl in English releases.

questions.q: Who rescues Astro from the robot circus and raises him?
questions.why: After Tenma sold him to the circus run by Hamegg, Professor Ochanomizu took him in.

questions.q: In which periodical did the Astro Boy manga run from 1952 to 1968?
questions.why: Kobunsha's Shōnen magazine serialized the manga, which was gathered into 23 volumes.

questions.q: Which studio produced the groundbreaking 1963 Astro Boy TV anime?
questions.why: Tezuka's Mushi Production made the 1963 show, the first hugely popular Japanese animated TV series.

questions.q: In what year did Astro Boy first appear, as a supporting character in Ambassador Atom?
questions.why: He debuted in Shōnen in April 1951 before getting his own series in 1952.

questions.q: Who voiced Astro Boy in the English version of the 2009 CGI film?
questions.why: Highmore voiced Astro in the 2009 film, while Aya Ueto took the Japanese role.

questions.q: Which mangaka wrote Pluto, a murder-mystery remake of an Astro Boy storyline?
questions.why: Urasawa's Pluto, serialized from 2003 to 2009, reimagines the Greatest Robot on Earth arc.
